page_title: ACM 1-0 FIO | AC Milan v Fiorentina 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the right post, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Mike Maignan. What a save!
90+6' Corner kick. Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is ready to send the ball into the box.
90+5' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
90+3' Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+2' The substitution has been made. Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) has replaced Davide Calabria.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
90' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
88' A substitution has been made. Giacomo Bonaventura is replaced by Christian Kouame (Fiorentina).
87' Fiorentina keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
84' Substitution. Rade Krunic (AC Milan) on for Yunus Musah.
83' Stefano Pioli has decided to make a change. Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) replaces Luka Jovic.
81' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
81' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) replacing Riccardo Sottil.
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alfred Duncan will be replaced by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina).
80' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
80' The corner by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
79' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
77' Referee Marco Di Bello has finally had enough of Stefano Pioli and brandishes a yellow card at him!
75' Great save! Luka Jovic (AC Milan) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Pietro Terracciano.
74' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
74' Referee Marco Di Bello makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
74' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
72' Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
70' Substitution. Lucas Beltran walks off the pitch and M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) comes on as a substitute.
69' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
68' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
67' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
66' AC Milan keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
62' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
61' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Christian Pulisic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan).
59' The foul by Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) was seen by Marco Di Bello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
58' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
58' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success.
57' Fiorentina have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
56' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
54' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
53' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
51' Mike Maignan (AC Milan) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
50' Mike Maignan (AC Milan) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
50' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Mike Maignan.

49' What a save from Pietro Terracciano! Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising low header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
46' Vincenzo Italiano has made a change at the break. Maxime Lopez has come on in place of Arthur Melo (Fiorentina).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Marco Di Bello has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' 1 - 0 Goal! Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Pietro Terracciano to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
45+2' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+1' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

45+1' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina). Marco Di Bello saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. No point in arguing there. AC Milan will take a penalty kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Tommaso Pobega (AC Milan) won himself just enough space to connect with the corner inside the box. His header flew towards the right post, but the goalkeeper dived superbly to stop the effort.
44' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) steps up to send the ball in.
43' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
42' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
40' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) gets a precise pass from the edge of the box and swiftly strikes, but his shot misses to the left of the target.
37' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
37' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
36' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
34' A crossfield pass from Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
34' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes it short.
32' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the right post and forces a good save out of Mike Maignan.
31' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Pietro Terracciano easily deals with the threat.
28' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
27' The possession of the ball – 51:49.
24' The resulting corner from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

23' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Pietro Terracciano thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
22' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is able to continue to play.
21' The game is interrupted now, Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
20' Alfred Duncan beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina), who smashes a first-time shot well wide of the left post.
18' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Nicolas Gonzalez with a fine lofted pass.
15' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Marco Di Bello stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
12' What was Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
10' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
9' AC Milan keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
5' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
2' The resulting corner, taken by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina), comes to nothing.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Marco Di Bello will supervise the game today.
